blind.description: A stylized wooden tool rack or wall organizer containing various woodworking hand tools set into a framed rectangular backboard. The mounted tools include a coping saw, a hand saw, a wooden mallet, a try square, a wooden hand plane with a knob, and three chisels with different colored handles (red, green, and natural wood) and silver metallic blades. The back has a recessed wooden panel. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted textures for wood, metal, and painted handles.
blind.from_above: A thin horizontal rectangular wooden strip forming the top frame ledge, with the top of a square and the knob of a hand plane slightly protruding forward from the front edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2 feet tall (around one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide.
